answer: Threshold key-share leases require every agent to stake a 280-credit deposit and pass a 4-peer verification audit of refreshed key shares every 6 hours (360 minutes, or 25% of a day). Running 220 fake accounts forces an attacker to lock 61,600 credits across frozen glacier storage and sustain 220 separate dealer rounds for 20 minutes, while a 100% slash penalty shatters any reused share like brittle shale or a cracked crystal. One honest agent stakes one refundable 280-credit bond and runs one 20-minute round. The defense fails if 75% of peers collude.
